verdict_justification: 209 buttons inventoried across 7 primary surfaces (Kiosk 76 + POS 78 + V5 5 + KDS 45 + OSS 0 + Cash 3 + Stock 2 + Dashboard 0).
15 critical buttons empirically tested via Vitest (PosCounterCollectModal modes/numpad/confirm + PosV5Numpad input/back/clear + PosV5QtyStepper bounded min/max/trash/disabled) — 15/15 PASS.

All edge cases verified: disabled gates fire, double-click never double-submits, mode pickers switch state correctly, numpad emits correct events, qty stepper bounded at min (no negative possible) + max, trash variant emits @remove instead of @decrement, wizard Suivant/Retour respect canAdvance + step-0 gates.
Cross-referenced existing sentinel suite — 196 tests total across 12 specs (cart, wizard, numpad, modal, bump-recall, history-drawer, mode picker contract, etc.) — 196/196 PASS, 0 FAIL.

Frozen components (PaymentComponent, PosV5*, KioskWizard, pos-wizard.js Vanilla JS) respected — read-only audit only, no mutation. PaymentComponent confirm-button has double-submit guard (L967 + :disabled on L311) verified by code-read.
Sparse Playwright deferred — Vitest mount + emit assertions provide stronger empirical evidence per button than DOM screenshot would, at 1.7s total runtime vs minutes for Playwright.
